model_annotation: The pie chart, labeled as Figure 4, displays the distribution of samples (in percentage) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart is divided into three distinct slices, each representing a different level of ambiguity: "Clear" (light blue, approximately 47.7%), "Somewhat Ambiguous" (medium blue, approximately 38.0%), and "Very Ambiguous" (dark blue, approximately 14.2%). The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting with the largest on the left. The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to the ambiguity categories and does not display percentage labels directly on the slices. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of clear conversations, which constitute the majority of the sample distribution.
